datasets.title: Wildfires east of Tyre, in South and El Nabatieh Governorates, Lebanon
datasets.description: UNOSAT code: FR20191016LBN This map illustrates satellite-detected burned areas in South and El Nabatieh Governorates, in Lebanon, based on SPOT-6 imagery acquired on 19 October 2019. Approximately 80 ha of potentially burned area were detected by UNOSAT as of 19 October 2019 (red), This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to UNITAR - UNOSAT.. [Source: This metadata record was automatically extracted from the Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX); Original dataset: https://data.humdata.org/dataset/wildfires-east-of-tyre-in-south-and-el-nabatieh-governorates-lebanon]
datasets.details: This is a preliminary assessment and has not yet been validated in the field. It is important to consider the characteristics of the source imagery used in the analyses when interpreting results. For damage assessments it should be noted that only significant damage to the structural integrity of the buildings analyzed can be seen in imagery, while minor damage such as cracks or holes may not be visible at all. For flood extractions using radar data it is important to note that urban areas and highly vegetated areas may mask the flood signature and result in underestimation of flood waters. Users with specific questions or concerns should contact unosat@unitar.org to seek clarification.

lineage.description: UNOSAT analysts reviewed SPOT-6 satellite imagery acquired on 19 October 2019 and compared it with reference imagery to detect notable changes in land cover. Burned areas were identified and digitized, with area measurements calculated in square meters and hectares. The preliminary analysis was conducted without field validation.

sources.name: UN Operational Satellite Applications Programme (UNOSAT)
sources.description: Satellite imagery analysis using SPOT-6 data to detect and map burned areas from wildfire events through multi-temporal image comparison
